notes.title: Recent changes
notes.notes:
Dear community,
The following changes to Project RPG have been performed:
[list]
[*] decreased the price to $0.99
[*] decreased the game file size by approximately half, without any loss of content
[*] rewrote the store page and the minimum/recommended hardware specifications
[*] optimized the Steam Cloud synchronization for savegames
[*] disabled a disimproving framerate optimization feature
[*] fixed an issue which does not count any playtime without the use of external software
[*] recreated a video sequence
[*] added automatic in-game healing when the character gets wounded
[/list]

notes.title: Displacement Studios taking over
notes.notes:
Dear community,
[url=http://www.displacementstudios.com]Displacement Studios[/url] acquired [i]Project RPG[/i] and is going to make a few improvements to it. So far it is planned to:
[list]
[*] decrease the price to $0.99
[*] decrease the game file size by approximately half, without any noticeable loss
[*] rewrite parts of the store page and recommended hardware specifications
[*] stop the game from offering a disimproving framerate optimization feature
[*] increase the in-game health automatically when the character gets wounded
[*] fix an issue which does not count any playtime without the use of external software
[*] reconfigure and optimize the Steam Cloud synchronization for savegames
[/list]
Any of these changes are likely being performed in the next few days and are implemented in some of our other games already. Feel free to add any suggestions as comments and stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Price Change!
notes.notes:
Today we decided we would drop the price a small bit for Project RPG. The game has been dropped in price a little over $1.

[b]Why?[/b]
We have decided to lower the price to apologize first of all for the lack of activity before this month. We have also decided to drop the price because Project RPG still has a few more big updates to go before leaving early access. Considering the game is not in its full state, we don't think you should have to pay full price. 

[b]Next update information:[/b]
We have been working recently on more side quests and map additions! We don't have a set date for the next patch, but stay updated with our Dev log thread in our forums for more information when we have some!

notes.title: Revamp - Ready to move forward
notes.notes:
Project RPG has issues to address, and we apologize for the lack of activity and updating. There has been an issue with the loss of multiple files. We are giving Project RPG's map a bit of a revamp.

First on our list of things to work on this week is tweaking the map and some optimization updates, aswell as some changes to the way plain look the game may seem it has. We also intend to include new quests for the next update or 2.

Once again we would like to apologize for the lack of activity, and the inconvenience regarding the loss of multiple models. But part of running an early access game is having difficulties here and there, and on our part it is working hard to get through them. We hope to push through some updates right away. 

And yes, the game has been developed in Gameguru. We also plan on soon adding in new models we are currently working on. But to update with as many new models as we would like, as well as other improvements, we need a bit of a larger budget. That is where our next game will come in if accepted through greenlight. It is ready in a full state, and if greenlit, most if not all of the earnings will be used towards updating Project RPG
